answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 42 POA per identity, released only after 15 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 540 fakes must lock 22680 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. A violet that can be verified, a reef that can be measured, and a oasis that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
